correctness.rationale: Every independent state of at least two cells lies in one row or column; any slide with at least two retained tokens would remain in that row or column and cannot traverse a categorical edge. The exact incidence tensor for TS_2 is proved bidirectionally from the literal token rule. BB^T=(t-2)I+J gives full nonzero singular values; rank and connectivity are established for m,n>=3. The Laplacian singular-pair factorization and Kirchhoff compute the tree formula with every multiplicity; exact integer cofactors checked at (3,3),(3,4), full numerical eigenspectra for nine profiles.

value.rationale: The two-token state graph of a natural dense graph product has an exact, nontrivial two-factor incidence architecture and explicit complete spectrum and spanning-tree complexity for infinitely many parameters. A sharp transition to universal freezing at k=3 explains the geometry of the feasible configuration space. This is structurally and enumeratively informative, unlike a routine scalar bound or arbitrary small numerical instance.
